bar_provider_limit.description: Maximum number of provider meters shown in the bar capsule; the panel and tooltip still include all providers.
bar_provider_limit.label: Bar provider limit

codexbar_path.description: Command or absolute path used to query enabled CodexBar providers.
codexbar_path.label: CodexBar command

main_window.label: Main usage window
main_window.description: Window shown by the thick bar and percentage, listed first in the panel, and used for the pace line. Weekly uses the 7-day window when the provider reports one; CodexBar order uses the first window CodexBar reports (usually the 5-hour session), like the upstream plugin.

bar_extra_bars.label: Thin bars under the main bar
bar_extra_bars.description: Other usage windows drawn as thin bars (1/3 of the main bar's height) under the main bar. Next window shows the one listed after the main window, e.g. the session under the weekly bar.
